title: Canonical Hom-sheaf comparison for a bounded finite locally constant source
statement: Let X be a scheme, B a finite commutative ring, and A,D objects of the derived category of etale B-module sheaves. Assume A is bounded and all its cohomology sheaves are finite locally constant [def-constructible-locally-constant]; assume D is bounded below [def-sbc-standard-tstructure-derived-category]. Then the canonical map derivedHomSheafComparison of [def-weil-pbc-derived-morphism-sheaf-comparison] from the pro-etale inverse image of the sheafification of actual local etale derived Hom to the sheafification of actual local pro-etale derived Hom of the pulled-back objects is an isomorphism. No perfectness or finite Tor-amplitude assumption is made.

source.place: Tags 08JI and 08JA, bounded-free RHom and its derived sections; Tag 094G, derived local constancy; finite-source extension in the parent evaluation node, steps 1-5 and 7

proof.text: Extract lower and upper cohomological bounds from the bounded source. Apply finite-ring derived local constancy to obtain an etale cover by bounded complexes of finite coefficient modules. Invoke the local finite-model comparison theorem, which proves the canonical comparison is invertible by the bounded-free RHom calculation and descent.

theorem derivedHomSheafComparison_isIso_lisse
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (B : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing B] [Finite B]
    (A D : DerivedCategory (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} B)))
    (hA : (DerivedCategory.TStructure.t
      (C := Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} B))).bounded A)
    (hAf : ∀ n : ℤ, IsFiniteLocallyConstantSheaf
      ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
        (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} B)) n).obj A))
    (hD : (DerivedCategory.TStructure.t
      (C := Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} B))).plus D) :
    IsIso (derivedHomSheafComparison X B A D)
